recipe.title: Crystal Tide
recipe.tagline: A tide observatory on a salt shelf. The 4-metre lens still points at Berth 2.
recipe.themeSummary: Gauge Pier, Berth 2 and the Lens Gallery of a tide observatory, grown over in salt crystal since Dr Aalto turned the 4-metre lens on the shallows to free the Petrel. The crystal is 30 cm thick on the lower decks and still climbing.

rooms.name: Prism Landing
rooms.description: Gauge Pier fog lamps fire from under the crystal on the left, in threes. The brine between the crystal shelves burns boots. Okonkwo's gauge 3 stands in the middle of it, reading 1.2 m.

rooms.name: Berth 2
rooms.description: Petrel deckhands in crusted survival suits come off the hull at a run, 6 of them. The pier piles are crystal to the arches. The Petrel's bow is 40 m out and 2 m deep in salt.

rooms.name: Lens Gallery
rooms.description: Aalto at the tilt wheel of the 4-metre lens, 31 degrees down, at the far end. The Anchor plinth stands under the lens in the beam. Along the north wall, 11 water cans, ten of them full.

lore.title: Gauge 3, 15 Rime
lore.source: tide-gauge log, page clipped to the gauge post
lore.text: 15 Rime, 06:00. Gauge 3: 1.2 m. Water 4 degrees. Sky clear. Remark: crystal on the surface from the pier to 40 m out. Walked on it to 10 m. It held. Reading sent 06:04. B. Okonkwo.

lore.title: Dive slate, 16 Rime
lore.source: plastic dive slate, grease pencil, tied to a pile
lore.text: DIVE 1. 3 M. CUT 3 M OFF HULL. 40 MIN AIR. DIVE 2. 4 M. CUT 3 M. 22 MIN. DIVE 3. 4 M. CUT 2 M. 9 MIN. LOW TIDE 19:10 IT IS ALL BACK. TORCH BOTTLE EMPTY. STORES SAYS THURSDAY. QUINTERO.

lore.title: Lens log, 17 Rime, 13:00
lore.source: lens log, bound, open at the last full page
lore.text: 17 Rime, 13:00. I have tilted the 4-metre lens 31 degrees below the horizontal onto Berth 2. The Petrel has 11 crew and 3 days of water. Quintero cut 8 m off the hull yesterday and it grew back in six hours; a torch will not do it. The beam boils brine at 4 degrees in 20 minutes by my tables. A boiled channel 3 m wide should let Alsted back off the berth. S. Aalto.

lore.title: Gauge 3, 17 Rime
lore.text: 17 Rime, 13:40. Gauge 3: 1.1 m. Water 91 degrees under the beam, 5 degrees at the gauge. Sky clear. Remark: the crystal at Berth 2 is climbing the piles at 10 cm a minute by my watch. It was 3 cm a day. Reading sent 13:44. B. Okonkwo.

lore.title: Dive slate, 18 Rime
lore.source: dive slate wedged in the Sluice 2 gate
lore.text: SLUICE 2 GATE SEALED. 20 CM SALT. NO TORCH, NO BOTTLE, STORES SAYS THURSDAY. ALSTED TOOK 10 OFF THE PETREL ON FOOT AT 05:00. I COUNTED 4 REACH THE PIER. QUINTERO.

lore.title: Lens log, 19 Rime
lore.text: 19 Rime. The lens stays on Berth 2 at 31 degrees; if the beam moves, the crystal under it sets in an hour and the Petrel is lost for good. I have 11 cans of water in the Lens Gallery, one for each of her crew. Okonkwo has not sent a reading since the 17th. The doors are salt to the lintel. S. Aalto.

lore.title: Survival suit, Petrel
lore.source: orange suit, salt through the seams
lore.text: Petrel survival suit, deckhand's size, 2 cm of crystal in every seam. On the sleeve in grease pencil, Quintero's hand: WALK IN MY STEPS, 05:00. Alsted took 10 of them onto the salt. Quintero counted 4 at the pier.

lore.title: Fog lamp housing
lore.source: brass lamp housing, crystal 4 cm over the glass
lore.text: Gauge Pier fog lamp, number 6 of 9. Okonkwo logged the crystal at 40 m out on 15 Rime and the lamps still under it lit at dusk. Through 4 cm of salt the beam comes out in three lines.

lore.title: Sluice 2 pump impeller
lore.source: steel impeller, salt-jammed on the shaft
lore.text: Impeller from a Sluice 2 brine pump. Aalto's log of 17 Rime has the pumps run at full to carry the boiled brine off Berth 2; the pumps threw it 12 m onto the pier instead and the crystal followed it. The impeller has 3 cm of salt on every blade.

lore.title: Lens mount wheel
lore.source: brass tilt wheel, 31 marked in red
lore.text: Tilt wheel from the 4-metre lens mount, 31 degrees marked in red where Aalto's hand wore the brass. Her log of 19 Rime: 11 cans of water, one for each of the Petrel's crew. Ten cans are still full.

attunements.name: Quintero's Boots
attunements.description: Hazard floor and area bolts deal 40% less. Quintero walked the Berth 2 salt in dive boots on 16 Rime and kept all ten toes.

attunements.name: Survival Suit, Petrel Issue
attunements.description: Melee and charge hits deal 25% less. The Petrel's suits are rated for 6 hours in 4-degree water; Alsted's crew wore them onto the salt.

attunements.name: Reading Sent 06:04
attunements.description: Reading a relic restores 25 Integrity. Okonkwo sent gauge 3 to the mainland every 6 hours for 9 years and missed one, on 18 Rime.

attunements.name: 31 Degrees
attunements.description: The Custodian takes 20% more damage. Aalto tilted the 4-metre lens to 31 degrees; at 32 the beam falls short of Berth 2 and the mount jams.

bible.premise: Crystal Tide is a tide observatory on a salt shelf: a 4-metre lens, three gauges on Gauge Pier, and a berth for the supply boat Petrel.
bible.collapse: Crystal grew 30 cm up the Petrel's hull in one night and froze her at Berth 2 with 11 crew. On 17 Rime at 13:00 lens-keeper Dr Sunniva Aalto tilted the 4-metre lens 31 degrees down to boil a channel. The brine under the beam boiled and the crystal grew back three times as fast, up the piles, over the pier and through the Lens Gallery doors.

events.fact: The Petrel tied up at Berth 2 with 11 crew and 6 tonnes of stores; by morning crystal had grown 30 cm up her hull.
Okonkwo read gauge 3 at 1.2 m and 4 degrees; the shallows had crystallised 40 m out from Gauge Pier.
Quintero cut 8 m of crystal off the Petrel's hull in three dives with the cutting torch; it grew back by the next low tide.
Aalto tilted the 4-metre lens 31 degrees down onto Berth 2 to boil a channel for the Petrel.
The brine under the beam boiled and the crystal came back at three times the rate, up the pier piles and over the deck.
Crystal sealed Sluice 2 and the Lens Gallery doors; Alsted's crew walked out over the salt toward Gauge Pier and did not reach it.
Aalto locked the lens on Berth 2 and stayed in the Lens Gallery with 11 cans of water.

authors.name: Bram Okonkwo
authors.register: Time, height in metres, water temperature, sky. Four short lines a reading. A remark only when the numbers change.

authors.name: Marisol Quintero
authors.register: Capitals, depth in metres, minutes of air left. Eight words a line at most. Jokes about stores.

authors.name: Sunniva Aalto
authors.register: Full sentences, lens angles in degrees, water in cans. Defends each decision in the sentence after it.

laws.name: Salt Underfoot
laws.description: Walking is 17% slower for crew and enemies and dashes recharge a third faster. The salt at Berth 2 is 2 m deep and wet on top.

laws.name: Aalto's Tables
laws.description: Operatives have 48 Integrity and deal 1.8x damage. Aalto's tables say brine boils under the beam in 20 minutes; skin takes 4 seconds.

laws.name: Fog on Gauge Pier
laws.description: Enemy attack sounds are muted; every telegraph lasts a third longer and draws brighter. Gauge Pier fog lamp 6 of 9 still lights at dusk under 4 cm of salt.
